verdict_rationale: DepreciationCalculator.tsx had 1 direct fetch() bypass: POST /api/valuation/depreciation (endpoint did not exist in backend). A new backend endpoint POST /api/costforge/depreciation-calculate was created in CostForgeController using existing GetDepreciationFactor bracket tables and BentonCostData. A new handler calculate_depreciation was added to handlers.real.ts (Wave 3 supplement) and registered. After wiring, handleCalculate routes through POST /pilot/invoke → ToolRunner gates → backend. Third fabric-corrected route.
